source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of phenylamine (PDF 124-126).

blocks.text: Phenylamine do qism ke reactions deta hai: benzene ring ke aur -NH2 group ke. Ring ke carbons sp2 hybridised hain; kitab nitrogen ko sp3 hybridised kehti hai, halanke is ka lone pair ring se milta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenylamine: Kekule benzene ring aik N atom se juri jis par lone pair aur do H atoms hain. 'sp2 hybridized' wali lakeer se teer ring ke carbons ki taraf; 'sp3 hybridized' se teer N ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine mein hybridisation: sp2 ring carbons aur nitrogen atom (kitab ke PDF safha 124 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ring ke chhe carbons sp2 hybridised hain. Kitab is drawing mein nitrogen ko sp3 kehti hai (teen bonds aur aik lone pair). Lekin Figure 24.1 (topic 24.3.1) mein kitab kehti hai ke nitrogen hamwar (planar) hai aur lone pair p orbital mein hai, jo sp2 jaisa hai. Haqeeqat in dono ke darmiyan hai: nitrogen thora sa pyramid jaisa hai, magar lone pair ka kaafi hissa ring par phail jata hai.

Amino group ortho-para directing hai aur benzene ring ko bohat reactive banata hai, khaas taur par in positions par. Is liye phenylamine ki bromination benzene se tez hai, aur dono ortho positions aur para position aik hi reaction mein substitute ho jati hain, 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine ka safaid precipitate banta hai: C6H5NH2 + 3Br2 -> C6H2Br3NH2 + 3HBr.

blocks.alt: Phenylamine (NH2 wali ring) + 3Br2 se 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine (safaid precipitate), jis ki ring mein oopar NH2 aur dono ortho aur para positions par Br hain, + 3HBr.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine ki bromination se 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine (kitab ke PDF safha 125 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: b) Nitrous acid ke saath: diazonium namak

Phenylamine, primary amine hone ki wajah se, nitrous acid se react kar ke diazonium namak banata hai; yeh diazotisation hai. Diazonium group, -N2+ (-N+ triple bond N likha jata), wale compounds diazo compounds hain. Nitrous acid sodium nitrite aur HCl se mixture mein hi banta hai, aur mixture ko barf se 10 C se neeche rakha jata hai, kyunke diazonium namak na-mustahkam hain aur kamre ke darje par bhi aasani se toot kar nitrogen chhorte hain: C6H5NH2 + HNO2 + HCl -> C6H5N2+ Cl- + 2H2O (10 C se neeche). Paani ke saath garam karne par namak phenol deta hai: C6H5N2+ Cl- + H2O -> C6H5OH + N2 + HCl.

blocks.alt: Teen satrein: NaNO2 + HCl se HNO2 + NaCl; phenylamine + HNO2 + HCl, 10 darje C se kam, se phenyldiazonium chloride (ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl-) + 2H2O; phenyldiazonium chloride + H2O, garmi (Heat), se phenol + N2 + HCl.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine ki diazotisation aur phenyldiazonium chloride se phenol (kitab ke PDF safha 125 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nitrous acid (HNO2) NaNO2 aur HCl se usi waqt banta hai, aur mixture 10 darje C se neeche rakha jata hai warna diazonium namak toot jata hai. Teesri satar mein diazonium namak paani ke saath garam (Heat) karne par phenol, N2 aur HCl deta hai. Chapter 22 (PDF safha 95) mein kitab yahi qadam NaOH ke saath likhti hai aur phenol + NaCl + N2 deti hai; yahan (safha 125) sirf paani ke saath garam karna likha hai. Dono mein N2 nikalti hai aur ring par -OH aata hai; NaOH ho to HCl ki jagah NaCl banta hai. Kitab ne 'HCl' ko 'Hcl' chhapa hai.

Alkyl diazonium namak har halat mein bohat na-mustahkam hain aur alag nahi kiye ja sakte, lekin aryl diazonium namak kam darja hararat par kaafi mustahkam hain. Yeh izafi istehkaam musbat charge ke aromatic ring par delocalised hone se aata hai. Benzenediazonium namak bohat se organic compounds banane mein ahem darmiyani maadde hain.

blocks.alt: Kekule benzene ring N(+) triple bond N se juri, + charge ring se jure nitrogen par.
blocks.caption: Benzene diazonium ion ki banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 125 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aryl diazonium namak phenols aur amines jaise bohat fa'aal aromatic compounds se react karte hain; yeh coupling reactions hain, aur in ke products, jin mein -N=N- bond ho, azo compounds hain. Musbat charge wala diazonium ion electrophile ka kaam karta aur phenol ke ring mein para position par substitute hota hai. Phenol ke saath coupling halke alkaline mehlool mein aur aromatic amines ke saath halke tezaab mein hoti hai: C6H5N2+ Cl- + C6H5OH -> C6H5-N=N-C6H4OH + HCl (NaOH), jis se 4-hydroxyazobenzene, narangi thos, banta hai.

blocks.alt: Do satron mein: benzenediazonium chloride (ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl-) + phenol (ring-OH), teer ke oopar NaOH, se p-hydroxyazobenzene (narangi thos), ring-N=N-ring-OH.
blocks.caption: Benzenediazonium chloride ki phenol se coupling (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Mechanism: Ph-N=N(+) + phenol (Kekule ring), O ke lone pair aur ring ke pi bonds se aakhri N tak curly arrows; darmiyani maadda Ph-N=N-C(H) ring jis mein C=O(+)H, C-H bond se ring mein aur C=O se O par curly arrows; phir H+ nikalne se p-hydroxyazobenzene (azo compound).
blocks.caption: Diazonium ion aur phenol ki coupling ka mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Qadam ba qadam: (1) diazonium ion ka aakhri nitrogen musbat hai, yeh electrophile hai. (2) Phenol ke oxygen ka lone pair ring mein dhakela jata hai aur ring ke pi electrons OH ke saamne wale (para) carbon se nitrogen par hamla karte hain. (3) Darmiyani maadde (intermediate) mein para carbon par N aur H dono hain aur oxygen par musbat charge hai. (4) Yeh carbon H+ chhorta hai, ring dobara aromatic ho jati hai aur p-hydroxyazobenzene banta hai. Kitab ne aakhri teer par '-H' likha hai; asal mein proton (H+) nikalta hai, is liye drawing mein -H+ hai.

items: Butter yellow: benzenediazonium chloride ethanoic acid mein N,N-dimethylphenylamine se couple ho kar 4-dimethylaminoazobenzene deta hai. Yeh kabhi khurak mein use hota tha lekin cancer ka sabab ban sakne ki wajah se ab mamnoo hai.

blocks.alt: Do satron mein: benzenediazonium chloride (Kekule ring) + N,N-dimethylphenylamine (ring-N(CH3)2), teer ke oopar CH3COOH, se p-dimethylaminoazo benzene (butter yellow), ring-N=N-ring-N(CH3)2, + HCl.
blocks.caption: Butter yellow ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Methyl orange, aik acid-base indicator, diazotised sulphanilic acid aur N,N-dimethylphenylamine se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Do satron mein: NaO3S-ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl- (diazotised sulphanilic acid) + N,N-dimethylphenylamine, teer ke oopar CH3COOH, se methyl orange, NaO3S-ring-N=N-ring-N(CH3)2, + HCl.
blocks.caption: Methyl orange ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 126 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne methyl orange ke product mein do nitrogen ke darmiyan teen lakeerein (N triple bond N) chhapi hain aur naam 'p-dimethylaminoazo benzene' likha hai. Dono ghalat hain: azo dye mein N=N (double bond) hota hai, aur 'p-dimethylaminoazobenzene' butter yellow ka naam hai. Methyl orange mein is ke ilawa -SO3Na group bhi hai. Is liye drawing mein N=N aur naam 'methyl orange' hai.

items: Azo group (Ar-N=N-Ar) chromophore hai: yeh azo dyes ke gehre rangon, peele aur narangi se surkh, neele aur hare tak, ka zimmedar hai, ring par doosre groups ke mutabiq. Bohat se khurak ke rangon mein azo dyes hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Phenylamine aur 2-methylphenol se azo dye kaise banayenge? Qadam, mua'adlat aur halaat batayein.
blocks.explanation: Qadam 1 (diazotisation): phenylamine ko halke HCl mein ghol kar 10 C se neeche NaNO2 ka mehlool milayein: C6H5NH2 + NaNO2 + 2HCl -> C6H5N2+ Cl- + NaCl + 2H2O. Qadam 2 (coupling): thanda diazonium mehlool NaOH(aq) mein ghule 2-methylphenol mein milayein: C6H5N2+ Cl- + HOC6H4CH3 -> C6H5-N=N-C6H3(CH3)OH + HCl. Azo group OH ke para par jurta aur rangeen azo dye banta hai.

items: Phenylamine + HNO2 (10 C se neeche): benzenediazonium chloride; paani ke saath garam: phenol + N2.
Diazonium ion + phenol (alkali) ya aromatic amine (tezaab): azo dyes (-N=N- chromophore).
